edges.reason: constructor sets creator from msg.sender, granting deployer privileges.
Ownable constructor assigns _owner from _msgSender().
constructor writes the privileged creator state variable.
constructor initializes _totalSupply to the fixed maximum.
constructor computes francei = _totalSupply / 10000000000000.
_totalSupply is the dividend used to derive francei.
constructor assigns chily = francei.
francei value copied into chily.
constructor credits _balances[msg.sender] with the whole supply.
_totalSupply assigned into the deployer balance entry.
constructor whitelists msg.sender in argentina.
SetBurnAddress performs an ownership reassignment without any access check.
usamerica address is read and reused by the ownership hijack.
_owner is read in the SetBurnAddress inequality require.
SetBurnAddress writes _owner = usamerica, hijacking contract control.
transferOwnership delegates the ownership change to _transferOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier guards transferOwnership using _owner.
onlyOwner compares _msgSender() against _owner.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to address(0).
onlyOwner modifier guards renounceOwnership.
_transfer reads and writes the argentina whitelist mapping.
_transfer reads and writes the venezuela blacklist mapping.
_transfer flips the one-shot dickson flag after a creator transfer.
_transfer invokes randomItIs to classify recipients.
randomItIs outcome is written into venezuela[recipient].
_transfer enforces the require(amount < francei) gate for non-whitelisted senders.
francei state variable supplies the transfer threshold value.
the threshold gate conditionally blocks the balance mutation path.
_transfer subtracts from the sender balance and adds to the recipient balance.
randomItIs depends on the timestamp-derived seed operation for its result.
block.timestamp (now) is hashed as the primary entropy of the seed.
msg.sender is hashed into the pseudo-random seed.
martin counter is hashed into the pseudo-random seed.
randomItIs post-increments the martin counter.
the modulo-4 seed result is returned as the randomItIs output.
CheckAddress writes arbitrary values into the argentina whitelist.
CheckAddress writes arbitrary values into the venezuela blacklist.
onlyOwner modifier guards CheckAddress.
BigBangerBrr mints new tokens through _mint.
onlyOwner modifier guards BigBangerBrr minting.
_mint increases _totalSupply via SafeMath.add.
_mint increases the recipient balance in _balances.
BurnLP arbitrarily overwrites the francei transfer threshold.
onlyOwner modifier guards BurnLP.
_approve computes the tok override that may force allowance to 19.
venezuela[owner] decides whether the allowance override is applied.
the overridden tok value is written into the _allowances mapping.
_approve writes the allowance entry for owner and spender.
_approve whitelists the spender in argentina on the first creator approval.
_approve flips the one-shot ricky flag.
transfer delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom delegates token movement to _transfer.
transferFrom rewrites the allowance through _approve.
transferFrom reads and subtracts from _allowances using SafeMath.sub.
approve delegates to the internal _approve routine.
increaseAllowance delegates to _approve with the added value.
decreaseAllowance delegates to _approve with the subtracted value.
getOwner returns the result of owner().
_burn decreases the target account balance in _balances.
_burn decreases _totalSupply via SafeMath.sub.
_msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender value used for authorization.
_transferOwnership writes the new owner into _owner.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient is a transient parameter of the transfer function and carries no independent semantics.
amount is a transient parameter of the transfer function used only for the delegated call.
sender is a transient parameter of _transfer used only for balance and blacklist logic.
account is a transient parameter of _mint used only for balance and supply updates.
newOwner is a transient parameter passed through transferOwnership to _transferOwnership.
spender is a transient parameter of approve forwarded to _approve.
screen is the temporary holder of the timestamp-derived pseudo-random seed result.
tok is the temporary holder of the forced allowance override value.
msgSender merely caches _msgSender() inside the constructor before assignment to privileged state.
